findings.finding: All six consensus rows (FY2026/FY2027 revenue and EPS, Q3 2026 revenue and EPS) cite nm_av_consensus, kind consensus, dated 2026-11-01. Under LAG_DAYS = 2 that source is not citable until 2026-11-03 (ticker-trace lists it in sources_not_yet_citable). So it cannot back the expectation gap, a driver, an event or the key risk at as_of 2026-11-01. The AV payload also does not state the EPS basis (GAAP or adjusted).
findings.where: gather/numbers.json consensus nm_cons_rev_fy2026, nm_cons_rev_fy2027, nm_cons_eps_fy2026, nm_cons_eps_fy2027, nm_cons_rev_q3_2026, nm_cons_eps_q3_2026 (source nm_av_consensus)
findings.fix: Do not redate the source. In position/core, keep consensus out of evidence_ids for drivers, events, key_risk and the gap comparison, and write a note: 'consensus retrieved 2026-11-01, not citable until 2026-11-03'. Alternatively, rerun with as_of 2026-11-03 or later, which would also cover the Q3 2026 results. If consensus EPS is used at all, label its basis as unknown.

findings.finding: Six KPIs cite only the AV call transcript dc_call_20260803 (provider_normalized), and the raw payload was not saved: US commercial customers 653, net dollar retention 157%, total RDV $13.1B, adjusted gross margin 86%, and international commercial and government revenue of $182M and $181M. They cannot be traced locally. The international splits agree with segment arithmetic (Gov 990.0 = 809 + 181; Com 945.4 = 764 + 182). The 10-Q shows a GAAP gross margin of 85% for Q2 and 86% for the six months, which does not confirm an adjusted 86% for Q2.
findings.where: gather/documents.json kpis dc_k_usc_customers, dc_k_ndr, dc_k_total_rdv, dc_k_adj_gm, dc_k_intl_com_rev, dc_k_intl_gov_rev
findings.fix: Do not let NDR or the customer count be the sole support of a driver unless they are confirmed in an issuer document. Otherwise cite them as transcript-only (unsaved) in notes. Relabel dc_k_adj_gm or replace it with the 10-Q GAAP gross margin (85% Q2 2026).

findings.finding: pf_net_income_fy2025 = 1,625,033k is net income attributable to common stockholders. Total net income in the 10-K is 1,634,644k (noncontrolling interests 9,611k). The value is correct, but the label 'net_income' does not say which basis it is.
findings.where: gather/_prefetch.json fact pf_net_income_fy2025 (10-K income statement, reading/10k_full.txt line ~1411)
findings.fix: Read it as attributable to common for EPS and per-share value; no number change needed. State the basis in a position note.

findings.finding: The Q1 2026 segment revenues are derived (six months minus Q2: 1,848,442 - 990,032 = 858,410 and 1,719,605 - 945,432 = 774,173). They are cited to the Q2 10-Q as if reported. The arithmetic is correct.
findings.fix: Mark them basis 'derived' in notes, or cite pf_10q_20260505 (Q1 10-Q), where they are reported.

findings.finding: The guidance track ratio of 1.082 (8 beats out of 8) mixes the annual FY2025 initial guide (+19.4%) with seven quarterly rows. The quarterly-only ratio is about 1.067. This is disclosed in the numbers notes, but a consumer that reads only the ratio overstates the typical beat.
findings.where: gather/numbers.json guidance_track row 'FY2025 (initial Feb-2025 guide)'; ticker-check track_record.ratio
findings.fix: When the guided midpoint is used as a floor for FY2026 Q3/Q4, apply the quarterly-only beat of about 1.067 (or show both), not 1.082.

findings.finding: Two press sources are marked independent=false but have syndicated_from null, so the original they copy is not named.
findings.fix: Name the original in syndicated_from, or use them only as leads (hypotheses) and never as evidence_ids for events.

findings.where: gather/documents.json guidance (no dc_g_fy_usc_prior; source pf_rel_20260504_1, reading/release_2026-05-04__a2026q1ex991pressrelease.txt line 63)
